MALACANAN'G \ 2000 "CONSTITUTING THE ECONOMIC COORDINATING Coordinating constituted on 6 January 2000 pursuant to Executive Order No. 193; the ECC is tasked to ensure the consistency complementation pronouncements, plans, programs and projects, and proposed legislations with the country's reform direction to further promote deregulation, liberalization, fair market competition, and increased private sector participation; there is need to provide the ECC with secretariat support to enable it to effectively perform its mandate. NOW, THEREFORE, I, JOSEPH EJERCITO ESTRADA, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution do hereby order: of a Full-Time ECC Secretariat. is hereby created ECC Secretariat technical and administrative support to the ECC and to the President, 1. all necessary preparations for the conduct of the ECC
